mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient ( patient_id, user_id, patient_name, age, gender, phone, address_id ) VALUES ( #{patientId}, #{userId}, #{patientName}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{address.addressId} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, a.street, a.city, a.state, a.pincode FROM patient p JOIN address a ON p.address_id = a.address_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address ( address_id, street, city, state, pincode ) VALUES ( #{addressId}, #{street}, #{city}, #{state}, #{pincode} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, a.street, a.city, a.state, a.pincode FROM patient p JOIN address a ON p.address_id = a.address_id WHERE p.patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.update: UPDATE patient SET patient_name = #{patientName}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, address_id = #{address.addressId} WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, a.street, a.city, a.state, a.pincode FROM patient p JOIN address a ON p.address_id = a.address_id WHERE p.active = TRUE
